origin: Borrowed from brutalist architecture, named after the French béton brut (raw concrete). On the web, it refers to raw, undecorated screens.
whenToUse: Portfolios or cultural event sites that show personality.
Archives where the content itself is the star.
An impression that breaks conventions is needed.
whenNotToUse: Shopping or financial services with many first-time users.
Pressable and non-pressable things can't be told apart.
A rough layout would harm the reading order.

alternatives.name: Neo-brutalism
alternatives.reason: A version with thick lines on a tidy grid.

accessibility: Since it uses default elements as they are, meaningful HTML structure becomes a strength.
Check text contrast in primary color combinations.
Make sure underlined text that isn't a link doesn't look like one.
